drafted_from: tool:find-scene-changes's own row in tools/media-composition/tool-rows.json, tools/media-composition/do-work/detect-scenes.mjs, and the script run on a synthetic 7 second clip (3 s red, 2 s blue, 2 s green)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Find where my video cuts from one shot to another." It runs tool:find-scene-changes and hands back the time in seconds of every cut.
no_lists_because: It reads one video you name by its file identity and answers from that video alone, so it keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find your video's identity in your files: 1f: then 64 hex.
2. Say "Find the scene changes in this video" with that identity. Add threshold (0.01 to 1, default 0.3): a higher threshold finds fewer, harder cuts.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:find-scene-changes. The door runs it in a container and answers {"result": {...}}; an error comes back as {"error": "what to change"}.
4. Read result.cuts (seconds, the very first frame is never counted) and result.count. Cut the video at those times, or raise the threshold if there are too many.
